species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 45°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–18 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 25 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 40 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 45°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
